highlights.title: A Cost-Effective Multimodal LLM Reasoning Framework for Question Answering over Irregular Clinical Time Series
highlights.summary: ClinPRISM is a multimodal LLM reasoning framework for question answering over irregular clinical time series.
highlights.detail: ClinPRISM addresses the limitations of existing multimodal time-series LLMs in modeling sparse clinical evidence. It uses an irregularity-aware multi-scale encoder and a temporal evidence distiller to integrate representations across diverse temporal scales.

highlights.title: Upcoming: Educational Codeforces Round 193 (Rated for Div. 2)

highlights.title: VetClaw: An Edge-Cloud Multimodal Agentic System for Veterinary Disease Screening
highlights.summary: VetClaw is an edge-cloud multimodal agentic system for veterinary disease screening.
highlights.detail: VetClaw enables the system to collect visual evidence, invoke external models, apply deterministic safety rules, and generate diagnostic-support alerts. It separates agent interaction from workflow orchestration.

highlights.title: CHARM: A Multimodal Graph Foundation Model with Hierarchical Context Modeling for Zero-Shot Transfer
highlights.summary: CHARM is a multimodal graph foundation model with hierarchical context modeling for zero-shot transfer.
highlights.detail: CHARM addresses the challenges of generalizing knowledge from individual modalities and capturing transferable cross-modal relations. It provides a foundation for zero-shot transfer on multimodal graphs.
